preconditions.description: The number of words n is an integer between 1 and 300 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(words, list) and len(words) == n and all(isinstance(w, str) and w.islower() and w.isalpha() for w in words)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n words, each consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(w) for w in words) + (n - 1 if n > 0 else 0) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The total length of the text (letters plus spaces) does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(min_length, int) and min_length == min(original_length, min((original_length - (count * (segment_length + (k - 1)) - count * k) for k, segment, count in all_valid_abbreviations if count >= 2) if any(c >= 2 for _, _, c in all_valid_abbreviations) else [float('inf')]))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum text length achievable by either performing no abbreviation or exactly one valid abbreviation. A valid abbreviation requires choosing a segment pattern that appears at least twice non-intersectingly, replacing all chosen occurrences with their uppercase initials, and calculating the resulting length. The result is the minimum of the original length and the best possible reduction.
